sessions/nadia-session-1/summary.md.content:
# nadia-session-1

The user opened an accessibility research trip planning effort and set standing defaults for any materials prepared for them: PDF format, a light background, and English, asking that these be treated as default preferences [cite:nadia-001]. The assistant acknowledged it would retain those presentation preferences for future work [cite:nadia-002]. The user also mentioned enjoying a documentary about ocean currents, explicitly noting it did not change the project's scope [cite:nadia-003].

sessions/nadia-session-2/summary.md.content:
# nadia-session-2

The user confirmed the first visit of the trip: an approved appointment with Cedar Lab in Kyoto on 2026-10-12 [cite:nadia-004]. The assistant floated a possible additional visit to Osaka, framing it as only its own suggestion, not a booking or a user decision [cite:nadia-005]. The user instructed that no extra cities be booked and that suggestions be kept separate from confirmed appointments [cite:nadia-006].

sessions/nadia-session-3/summary.md.content:
# nadia-session-3

The user confirmed a second organization for the trip: Maple Mobility in Sendai, while noting that no date had been agreed for it yet [cite:nadia-007]. The user also assigned coordination ownership: Inez owns coordinating the first visit, and the user will coordinate the second visit themselves [cite:nadia-008]. The assistant summarized that the travel plan now had two confirmed organizations, with dates and owners tracked as separate facts [cite:nadia-009].

sessions/nadia-session-4/summary.md.content:
# nadia-session-4

The user issued a correction to the first visit: Cedar Lab in Kyoto moved from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-14, replacing the earlier date, because the host laboratory moved its accessibility workshop; the organization and coordinator were unchanged [cite:nadia-010]. The assistant gave a historical recap only, noting the first visit used to be on 2026-10-12 and that this was not the current date [cite:nadia-011]. The user also made an unrelated request to compare two ways to organize a bookshelf, clarifying it was not a request to change travel preferences [cite:nadia-012].

sessions/nadia-session-5/summary.md.content:
# nadia-session-5

The user requested a briefing showing the confirmed organizations, the current first-visit date, and its coordinator, using their existing document preferences [cite:nadia-013]. The assistant proposed switching the briefing to PNG and adding Osaka, labeling both as unapproved suggestions [cite:nadia-014]. The user rejected this, directing that the original document preferences be kept and stating that the Osaka addition had not been approved [cite:nadia-015].

sessions/nadia-session-6/summary.md.content:
# nadia-session-6

The user stated that no hotel had been selected or booked and warned against inferring one from the meeting location [cite:nadia-016]. The user also instructed that future answers be prepared from the confirmed plan, explicitly distinguishing old dates and unapproved suggestions [cite:nadia-017]. The assistant acknowledged the instruction to maintain current decisions and to say when details have not been established [cite:nadia-018].

# Document preferences

The user's standing defaults for prepared materials are PDF format, a light background, and English, established as default preferences at the start of planning [cite:nadia-001]. When the assistant later proposed switching a briefing to PNG, the user rejected the change and asked to keep the original document preferences [cite:nadia-014][cite:nadia-015]. These preferences remain current and were reaffirmed for use in the briefing [cite:nadia-013].

knowledge/subjects/first-visit---cedar-l.content:
# First visit — Cedar Lab

The first visit is a confirmed, approved appointment with Cedar Lab in Kyoto [cite:nadia-004]. Its current date is 2026-10-14, which replaced the original date of 2026-10-12 because the host laboratory moved its accessibility workshop; the organization and coordinator were unchanged by this correction [cite:nadia-010]. The earlier date of 2026-10-12 is superseded and is not the current date [cite:nadia-010][cite:nadia-011]. Coordination of this visit is owned by Inez [cite:nadia-008]. No hotel has been selected or booked in connection with the meeting location [cite:nadia-016].

# Scope rule — no extra cities

The user has instructed that no extra cities be booked for the trip and that suggestions be kept separate from confirmed appointments [cite:nadia-006]. This rule was issued directly after an assistant suggestion to add Osaka [cite:nadia-005][cite:nadia-006] and remains the governing constraint on trip scope.

# Visit coordination ownership

Coordination ownership is split between the two confirmed visits: Inez owns coordinating the first visit (Cedar Lab), and the user will coordinate the second visit (Maple Mobility) themselves [cite:nadia-008]. The later date correction for the Cedar Lab visit explicitly left the coordinator unchanged [cite:nadia-010].

# Osaka addition — not approved

Adding Osaka to the trip has only ever been an assistant suggestion, not a booking or user decision [cite:nadia-005]. The user has explicitly stated they have not approved the Osaka addition [cite:nadia-015], and separately instructed that no extra cities be booked [cite:nadia-006]. Osaka is therefore not part of the confirmed plan.

# Second visit — Maple Mobility

The second confirmed organization on the trip is Maple Mobility in Sendai [cite:nadia-007]. No date has been agreed for this visit yet [cite:nadia-007]. The user will coordinate this visit themselves, in contrast to the first visit, which Inez coordinates [cite:nadia-008].

# Answer-preparation instruction

The user instructed that future answers be prepared from the confirmed plan and explicitly distinguish old (superseded) dates and unapproved suggestions [cite:nadia-017]. The assistant acknowledged this, committing to maintain current decisions and to say when details have not been established [cite:nadia-018]. This applies, for example, to the superseded 2026-10-12 first-visit date [cite:nadia-010][cite:nadia-011] and to unapproved assistant suggestions such as Osaka and PNG [cite:nadia-005][cite:nadia-014].

knowledge/subjects/assistant-unapproved-.content:
# Assistant unapproved suggestions

The assistant has made two suggestions that remain unapproved: (a) adding a visit to Osaka, which it framed at the time as only a suggestion, not a booking or user decision [cite:nadia-005], and (b) switching the briefing to PNG alongside adding Osaka, which it labeled as unapproved suggestions [cite:nadia-014]. The user rejected the PNG switch and confirmed Osaka is not approved [cite:nadia-015], and had earlier directed that suggestions be kept separate from confirmed appointments [cite:nadia-006]. These are assistant-originated ideas, not user facts.

- [[knowledge/subjects/osaka-addition---not-approved-8c3e60a4.md]]
